caption: The image shows a drawing of a carved wooden figure of a man dressed in traditional Scottish Highland attire. The figure is shown from the front and is attached to a base that appears to be part of a ship's bow or similar structure. The man wears a green jacket with gold trim and decorative buttons, a sash crossing from his left shoulder to his right hip, and a patterned kilt with yellow, red, and black arranged in a tartan design. He also wears matching tartan stockings and black shoes with gold buckles. His right hand is positioned across his chest, while his left arm is bent at the elbow with the hand near his waist. Around his waist is a sporran, which is a light tan color with a central patch featuring red tassels or decorations. The man wears a round, flat-topped hat that matches the colors of his jacket. The base features carved and painted gold scrollwork. The overall color palette includes shades of green, gold, red, black, and tan. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Figurehead: "The Highlander"
